title: The Node Runtime & Event Loop
objectives: Explain the single-threaded event loop model
Identify operations that block the loop
Offload CPU work to worker threads

examples.name: blocking.js

exercise.prompt: Classify each operation: "fs.readFileSync on a 10MB file" (blocks), "await fetch to an API" (non-blocking), "hashing 500MB with crypto.sync" (blocks), "await db.query" (non-blocking).
hints: Sync file/CPU operations hold the loop; awaited I/O yields.
Everything queued waits while one sync call runs.

options: a single-threaded event loop with async I/O
questions.explanation: I/O concurrency comes from the event loop; CPU work needs workers.

questions.prompt: A 2-second synchronous hash in a handler affects…
questions.explanation: The loop is shared: one sync CPU stall delays the entire process.
